description: This file defines the CustomerDao class in the OrangeHRM Time plugin, responsible for database operations related to Customer entities, including retrieval, search, validation, and deletion of customer data within the HRM system.

classes.name: CustomerDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for performing database operations on Customer entities within the OrangeHRM Time plugin.

methods.name: getCustomerById
methods.description: Retrieves an active Customer entity by its ID. Returns null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingCustomerIds
methods.description: Fetches a list of existing customer IDs from a provided list of IDs, only including non-deleted customers.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Marks specified customers as deleted after ensuring they have no associated timesheet items; handles transaction management.

methods.name: saveCustomer
methods.description: Persists a Customer entity to the database.

methods.name: searchCustomers
methods.description: Performs a search for customers based on filter parameters, returning matching Customer entities.

methods.name: getSearchCustomerPaginator
methods.description: Configures and returns a paginator for customer search results based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchCustomersCount
methods.description: Returns the count of customers matching search filter parameters.

methods.name: isCustomerNameTaken
methods.description: Checks if a customer name is already taken by an active customer, optionally excluding a specific customer ID.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a Customer entity by ID, regardless of deletion status.

methods.name: getCustomerIdList
methods.description: Returns a list of customer IDs, optionally including deleted customers.

methods.name: getCustomerIdListForProjectAdmin
methods.description: Returns customer IDs associated with a specific project admin's employee number, optionally including deleted customers.

methods.name: hasCustomerGotTimesheetItems
methods.description: Checks if the customer has associated timesheet items.

methods.name: getUnselectableCustomerIds
methods.description: Returns customer IDs that are associated with timesheet items, making them unselectable for certain operations.

methods.name: deleteRelativeProjectsForCustomer
methods.description: Deletes associated projects and related entities for given customer IDs.

methods.name: deleteRelativeProjectActivitiesForProject
methods.description: Marks related project activities as deleted.

methods.name: deleteRelativeProjectAdminsForProject
methods.description: Deletes project admin records for specified project IDs.
